title: nazm.delta/1
description: What changed between a baseline `nazm.snapshot/1` and the current compilation of the same root, from `nazm delta --json` and the `nazm-mcp` tool `nazm.semantic_delta`. Definitions are matched by durable key only: a rename is a removal and an addition. A changed definition names exactly which recorded sections changed; `source` alone is a change in text the other recorded sections do not see. Nothing here claims behaviour is unchanged: `unsupported` lists what is not recorded. `status` is `available` with every section, or `unavailable` with a `reason` and no other section.

reason.description: Why there is no delta: the current compilation has no snapshot, or the baseline is not exactly a `nazm.snapshot/1` of this root by this compiler. A baseline is refused, never compared as well as it can be. Present only when `status` is `unavailable`.

added.description: In the current compilation and not the baseline, where each is declared now. Ordered by identity.

removed.description: In the baseline and not the current compilation, where each was declared. Ordered by identity.

changed.description: In both, with a different digest in at least one recorded section. Ordered by identity.

unchanged.description: In both, with every recorded section's digest equal.

unsupported.description: Not recorded, so never reported as changed or unchanged.

sections.description: Whether each recorded section's digest differs. `callers` and `callees` are null for a record or an enum: not applicable.
